For music players with their own DAC. Opens the headphone or line output exclusively at each track\'s own rate. Not every device grants exclusive mode.
BitChord drives the DAC itself, on any Android version, and sets its volume on the DAC. Asks for USB permission. Can be much louder than normal output.

BitChord can\'t set this kind of DAC\'s volume, so it plays at full scale and only the DAC\'s own knob, if it has one, controls loudness. This can be dangerously loud with sensitive headphones.
Converts tracks above your DAC\'s limit to its highest format. Tracks may take longer to start and won\'t be bit-perfect to the original.
The DAC gets the music at full scale, and the phone\'s volume buttons may stop working. Turn the DAC or amplifier down before you play.
